changelog:
**Summary: Improved and clarified the heartbeat workflow; restricts model use and adds resilience to failures.**

Updated to work with the Openclaw Projects and Build a dev team skills more cohesively   |   https://clawhub.ai/encryptshawn/openclaw-projects   |  https://clawhub.ai/encryptshawn/build-dev-team

- Heartbeat scheduling and model selection are now explicitly defined, using the cheapest available model for scheduled runs.
- Clarifies that heartbeat is platform-triggered and never self-invoked or persistent.
- All heartbeat actions must use project and queue GIDs stored in `HEARTBEAT.md`; only perform discovery if missing or invalid.
- If the heartbeat fails for any reason, it immediately stops without retrying, troubleshooting, or escalating.
- Queue checks now also require reading `queues/to-engineer.md` for escalations, not just Asana tasks.
- Updated protocol to clarify that `sessions_send` should never be sent to self and is only a nudge, not the record.
- Added notes for projects using ClickUp instead of Asana.
